issues.description: The problem statement (and UML) specifies that Animal's constructor and the name getter/setter should have protected visibility, but the solution implements the Animal constructor and its getName()/setName() methods as public. This mismatch between the specified visibility and the solution implementation can confuse students who are instructed to declare these members as protected (and may attempt to follow the UML precisely).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Animal constructor and the getName()/setName() methods protected in the implementation to match the UML and the textual instruction in the problem statement. Alternatively, if public visibility was intended, update the problem statement/UML to state public visibility for these members so instructions and implementation agree.
